cards.card_text: Then comes Saul's family: his sons Jonathan, Ishvi and Malchishua, his daughters Merab and Michal, and his wife Ahinoam.
cards.verse_text: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua.
cards.snippet: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua.

cards.card_text: Saul became Israel's king (1 Samuel 11:15), and the sons listed here are Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab and Esh-baal.
cards.verse_text: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
cards.snippet: …was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

cards.card_text: Jonathan's brothers Abinadab and Malchishua are killed too.
cards.verse_text: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and his sons, and they killed Saul’s sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
cards.snippet: …Saul and his sons, and they killed Saul’s sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua.
